jury_question: If EU students get home fees, who should pay the gap between home and international fees?
jury_options: Taxpayers, from a named, capped budget line that is published each year
Employers who recruit through the youth scheme, by a charge
No one here: home fees only for countries that give UK students the same rate back
No home fees: say no and keep the rest of the deal, even if the EU objects
note: s1-s5 opened 23 Nov 2026 and found to say what they are cited for. s4 and s1 were the only sources used by answers; s1 cited by A and B for nothing, removed.
